note: Development sample. Not scheduled content — five obvious landmarks, so a fresh clone can play the game without a database. Real content lives in Postgres and never in this repo.

locations.name: The Empire State Building
locations.factShort: A development sample, not real content. The Empire State Building went up in 410 days during the depths of the Depression.

locations.name: The Brooklyn Bridge
locations.factShort: A development sample, not real content. The Brooklyn Bridge opened in 1883 and was the longest suspension bridge in the world at the time.

locations.name: The Unisphere
locations.factShort: A development sample, not real content. The Unisphere was built as the theme symbol of the 1964 New York World's Fair.

locations.name: Yankee Stadium
locations.factShort: A development sample, not real content. The current Yankee Stadium opened in 2009 across the street from the original.

locations.name: The Wonder Wheel
locations.factShort: A development sample, not real content. The Wonder Wheel has turned at Coney Island since 1920 and carries both swinging and stationary cars.
